title: Invisible Cities
author: Italo Calvino
summary: Marco Polo describes dozens of imaginary cities to the ageing emperor Kublai Khan. Each short piece is a poetic fable about memory, desire, time and how we see places.
readIf: you like short, lyrical, imaginative books you can dip into and ponder.
skipIf: you need plot and characters, since this is a series of prose-poem sketches.
